description.p: Shadow is a private, self-hosted personal AI workspace for a single operator: chat, autonomous agents, MAGI tri-model deliberation, long-term memory, deep research, a productivity suite (mail, calendar, notes, tasks, documents), and a music player. The desktop app runs the same stack as the server deployment locally, so every feature behaves identically.

ul.li: Chat with any local model or API (Ollama, llama.cpp, OpenAI, OpenRouter, …)
Agents that run real tools (web, files, shell, skills, memory) via MCP
MAGI — tri-model deliberation with vote, debate, and judge modes
Memory, deep research, and a full productivity suite

description.p: First desktop release: native launcher, MAGI streaming, serpent emblem.
